subject: Red Team & AppSec SOW — scope, SLAs, evidence
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@scarletsec.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Red Team & AppSec SOW - initial scope + SLA questions

Alex —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to move from discovery into contract prep for an annual engagement that covers a focused red team (external infra + auth flows) plus an application security assessment for our public API. Before I loop Procurement/Legal, can you: 

- Share a draft SOW with explicit deliverables and test windows (we prefer 48–72 hour test windows for live infra).
- Confirm SLAs for report delivery and remediation verification (we need 30 days for draft report, 45 days for final; retest SLA?).
- Confirm evidence you can provide (sample report, SOC2 Type II, background check attestations for testers).
- Provide a scoped pricing worksheet that separates red team, appsec, and optional 3-month retest credits.

I've attached our procurement rubric to show scoring priorities (risk impact, false positive rate, tester credentials, delivery time, insurance). We'll use that to evaluate limited shortlist vendors.

Goal: get an SOW + pricing we can route to Procurement+Legal by the end of next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: procurement_rubric.xlsx

From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@scarletsec.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: sales@scarletsec.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Red Team & AppSec SOW - initial scope + SLA questions

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the rubric, very helpful. Attached is our SOW_v2 (redlineable PDF) and a scoped pricing sheet. A few notes up front: 

- Deliverables: executive summary, full technical report with reproducible steps, prioritized remediation matrix (CWE mapping), and a 2-hour walkthrough for engineering.
- Test windows: we typically work in 48-hour windows for external infra and 72 hours for authenticated app flows. We can compress to 24 hours for targeted tests on an agreed maintenance window with an added surge fee.
- Report SLAs: draft report within 21 business days from test completion; final report (post-clarifications) within 10 business days. We can commit to an expedited 10/5 schedule for an additional 15% fee.
- Evidence: attaching a redacted sample report and our SOC2 Type II attestation. We perform background checks on all red teamers and can supply attestations if required.

We included optional line items for retest credits and ADT (adversary emulation) exercise add-ons. If you want to lock an annual retest bucket, we can offer a 12% discount on total contract value.

I can jump on a short call with Karthik to talk technical constraints if helpful.

Best,
Alex Jordan
Principal Consultant, ScarletSec
alex.jordan@scarletsec.com
+1 212 555 0147

Attachments: SOW_v2_redteam.pdf, pricing_sheet_scoped.xlsx

Subject: Re: Red Team & AppSec SOW - initial scope + SLA questions

Alex / ScarletSec —

Thanks for the draft SOW and the sample report. A few clarifying items from an engineering/security operations perspective: 

1) Scoped targets: please enumerate exact target hostnames and service tags in the SOW appendix rather than a generic CIDR block — this speeds approvals.
2) Attack surface: for authenticated app flows, we need tester access via dedicated test accounts (no live customer data). We'll provide a staging token exchange endpoint; please confirm you will not reuse tokens or snapshots beyond the engagement.
3) Evidence & credentials: we require SOC2 Type II and proof of tester background checks (redacted PK and date). Also include cyber insurance limits (minimum $5M per occurrence).
4) Retest policy: we prefer one included retest for high/critical findings at no charge within 60 days; additional retests bill at a reduced hourly rate.
5) Escalation: add a P1 on-call contact for any accidental service-impacting test activity.

If you can update the SOW with those specifics, Procurement can then ingest it. We're ok with the 12% annual retest discount if the SLA windows and insurance language match our requirements.

-Karthik
Director, Applied Security
Redwood Inference

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com, ops@scarletsec.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Red Team & AppSec SOW - initial scope + SLA questions

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear notes. Confirming each point below and noting SOW updates we'll push in the next revision: 

1) Targets: we'll add an appendix with hostnames and scope tags and include a redline-friendly spreadsheet for approvals.
2) Authenticated flows: agreed — we'll use test accounts only and include a non-reuse clause in Section 4.2.
3) Evidence: attaching our redacted SOC2 Type II attestation (scarletsec-SOC2-2026.pdf). We can also supply tester background-check attestations on request; we'll need a mutual NDA addendum for the details.
4) Retest: we'll include one complimentary retest of high/critical issues within 60 days; additional retests at 50% of standard hourly rate.
5) Escalation: adding a 24x7 P1 on-call contact and an emergency kill-switch procedure for tests that risk availability.

Pricing note: if you sign an annual contract (12 months, 1 retest included), we can commit to the 12% discount and hold today's pricing for 90 days. I'll send a DocuSign envelope with the updated SOW + pricing and include the SOC2 attestation.

Alex Jordan
Principal Consultant, ScarletSec

Attachments: scarletsec-SOC2-2026.pdf
